positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Maple Grove, Minnesota, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Engineer - Data Architecture
positions.description:
- Architected and implemented new data solutions for all SingleComm products
- Implemented and managed a Looker BI suite
- Created and maintained a RESTful, reactive event-sourced data-service framework using Scala Play, Couchbase, Kinesis and Redshift
- Created Typescript serverless microservices for the SingleComm architecture
- Maintained custom reports, queries in legacy MySQL and PostGres databases
- Served as a subject matter expert for data architecture / reporting
- Researched new technologies that can help existing and new data solutions

positions.title: Data Architect
positions.description:
-	Designed, implemented and maintained strategic data-solutions through distributed technologies in order to support core business requirements 
-	Identified and executed on optimization opportunities with existing data solutions 
-	Produced architectural diagrams that support product development 
-	Acted as a subject-matter expert for other team members in order to maximize the value of data-solutions 
-	Participated in the process of gathering functional requirements 
-	Set and enforced standards for data-management 
-	Researched new and current technologies that can support current and future solutions

positions.title: Help Desk Intern
positions.description:
•	Creates monthly faculty scheduling
•	Maintains a database of departmental coordinators 
•	Programs Perl scripts to measure the performance of help desk employees

positions.title: Senior Help Desk Analyst
positions.description:
•	Assisted customers, via phone, email, or in person, with basic troubleshooting involving Iowa State University computer applications, as well as other supported software and hardware

•	Trained newer employees by listening to their phone conversations and offering advice

•	Managed and supervise any non-senior employees
